units.title: Retention challenge 1
units.lesson: Retrieve the idea from memory before reading the feedback. A small recall result is evidence from these questions only.
units.question: A new diagram focuses on the relationship of the upper and lower teeth when meeting. Which heading fits?
units.explanation: Occlusion names the upper-lower bite relationship.
rationales: A count does not specify contact.
Crown shape alone is not the bite relationship.

units.question: What best explains why retention follows active orthodontic movement?
choices: Retention helps maintain achieved tooth positions
units.explanation: Retention addresses the possibility of later tooth-position changes.
rationales: The need for retention reflects possible change.
units.hint: Recall the goal of the later phase.
